Reviewer: Corinne Hadfield
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
Visit: weekday lunch, first time
For the better part of a year, a colleague named Delphine had urged me to try The Millstream Kitchen, and one recent weekday I finally gave in. The place sits a short walk from my office, though that was never what had kept it on my mind.
The weekday set lunch is the reason to come. Three courses arrive for a flat eighteen dollars, which is less than one main dish alone costs from the regular menu. I started with a squash soup, moved on to grilled river trout, and finished with a lemon tart.

Trade Floor
Machinery maker brings free demonstrations to three towns
Merrow Machinery Company has announced a series of free open demonstration sessions that will travel across the region this autumn, opening in Calderton on September 4. The company says the sessions are meant for workshop staff who want to keep their own equipment running well and to reduce the number of service calls they make to outside firms.
Each session covers routine cleaning, day-to-day safety checks, and the small repairs that operators can carry out for themselves. A company engineer leads every visit, demonstrates each task on a working machine, and takes questions from those attending.
The tour will stop in three towns on the following dates:
Date	Town	Venue
September 4	Calderton	Civic Hall
September 11	Redmarsh	Trade Center
September 18	Elsworth	Showground Pavilion
Admission is free of charge, but the number of places at each stop is limited, so visitors must reserve a seat in advance by telephoning the company's visitor desk.
Reported by Hector Vaughn
----------------------
To: Gerald Ashworth
From: Paulette Grimshaw
Date: September 2
Subject: Machinery demonstration in Redmarsh
Dear Gerald,
As you know, I will be traveling to our parts supplier just outside Redmarsh next week for a separate matter. It turns out that Merrow Machinery Company brings its free demonstration to that town on September 11, the very day I will be there, so I could attend rather than travel to an earlier stop nearer our Whitcombe office.
Would you be able to look over the topics the session will cover and mark anything you think our team should learn? I would really value your opinion before we agree on our maintenance plan for the year.
To make that easier, I will send you the printed demonstration leaflet later this week, so you can study the full list of topics well before our planning meeting on September 24.
Best regards,
Paulette Grimshaw
Facilities Assistant
